lines.en: Move slowly, or fall through a hole.
The ice is thin; I keep to the edge.
My tail sweeps the broken ice aside.
My four short legs slip on the ice.
Belly to the ground, I am steadier.
Rain in the ice spikes falls hard.
Frost piles deeper on my back.
The spikes block me; I go around.

lines.zh: 腿短不是我的错，冰面太滑。
lines.en: Short legs are not my fault; the ice is slick.
I crawl along the ice crack.
The ice spikes — I know them well.

lines.zh: 我甩你上天，再让你慢慢落。
lines.en: I flip you up and let you fall slowly.
The snow is deep; each step sinks.
Among ice spikes, my scales are white.

lines.zh: 冰刺之地也有我的脚印。
lines.en: Even the ice spikes bear my tracks.
From one end of the spikes to the other.
The wind carries the smell of blood.
A little more sun, then I dive.

lines.zh: 冰风把我的呼吸冻成白烟。
lines.en: The wind freezes my breath to white smoke.
The cold makes me forget my plan.

lines.zh: 冰刺之地这么冷，我照样晒太阳。
lines.en: The ice spikes are cold, and I still bask.

lines.zh: 冰刺之地的水，冷得省力。
lines.en: Ice spike water is cold enough to slow me.
Something moves beneath the ice.
Snow settles on my back and stays.

lines.zh: 冰刺之地，我趴着一动不动。
lines.en: On the ice spikes I lie perfectly still.
Ice-spike shade is the coolest.
I wait for the ice to thicken.

lines.zh: 只露眼睛，其余都在冰下。
lines.en: Only my eyes show; the rest is under ice.

lines.zh: 冰刺之地的冷，让我的牙更利。
lines.en: Ice spike cold keeps my teeth sharp.

lines.zh: 冰刺之地，冻得我懒得动。
lines.en: The ice spikes make me too cold to move.
Lying on the ice is best.
I am counting the ice spike tips.

lines.zh: 你站在冰刺中间，走错了。
lines.en: You stand among the spikes; wrong place.

lines.zh: 冰上的我一动不动，等你。
lines.en: Still on the ice, waiting for you.
Do not step on those spikes; they break.

lines.zh: 这一口带毒，别怪我没说。
lines.en: This bite is venomous — you were warned.
The frost on your sword looks fine.

lines.zh: 人类，你手里拿的是什么？
lines.en: Human, what's that in your hand?
Your steps ring too loud on the ice.
On the ice spikes, I still thrive.

lines.zh: 你是来凿冰的，还是送饭的？
lines.en: Are you here to cut ice or to feed me?

lines.zh: 你的热气喷到我脸上了。
lines.en: Your warm breath hits my snout.
That hat of yours is odd.
Hold still and let me look at you.
Is my tail still there?
When it hurts, I bite harder.
A scale was knocked off.

lines.zh: 我把人抛上天，再给他一点毒。
lines.en: I toss you up, then add a touch of poison.
Ice spikes dig into my scale seams.
I growl and ice chips fall.
So cold my scutes won't close.

lines.zh: 冰刺之地的冷，我受得住。
lines.en: I can bear the cold of the ice spikes.
My scales are brittle with cold.
Who struck my back plates?

lines.zh: 你手里是什么，冒着热气。
lines.en: What steams in your hand?
Fish! I smell fish!
Lower it; I cannot reach.

lines.zh: 冰刺里这么冷，我还在动。
lines.en: It's freezing among the spikes and I'm still moving.

lines.zh: 冰刺之地的冷，冻住我的牙。
lines.en: Ice-spike cold locks my teeth.
This meat is frozen solid.
Ice spikes work into the gaps of my scales.
What you brought pleases me.
One more piece; my teeth are still cold.
My tail taps against the ice.
You take one step; I crawl two.
One small piece, and I let go.
One venomous bite and you'll go numb.
Is that fish, or your fingers?
This beats frozen fish.
Last time you brought meat too.

lines.zh: 冰面上你一踩，我就滑出去。
lines.en: One step on the ice and I slide away.

lines.zh: 别挤，我只是一截冰里的鳄。
lines.en: Do not shove; I am just a gator in the ice.
Hitting you numbs my teeth.

lines.zh: 我背上的冰刺扎到你了。
lines.en: The spikes on my back caught you.
Another bump and the ice cracks.
My scales are knocked askew.

lines.zh: 把你抛上去，再补一口毒。
lines.en: Up you go, and a dose of poison after.

lines.zh: 你一撞，我背上的冰刺响。
lines.en: At your bump, the ice spikes on my back rattle.
The crack is too narrow for me.
I am not hungry; go.
The ice on my back scrapes loudly.
Nose to nose, the ice as witness.
So we count as a pair now, right?
You sit on the eggs; I guard outside.
Slow down, the ice is slick.
Don't be shy, look up at me once.
My teeth will not touch you.
Before the ice melts, let us nest.
The nest under the ice is solid.
Your scales shine under the ice.
One more piece for my cold collection.
Did you see me pick that up?

lines.zh: 雪下的东西，我刨得出来。
lines.en: Whatever is under the snow, I dig up.
I keep this ice crystal.

lines.zh: 路过而已，顺手就叼上了。
lines.en: Just passing by, and it came along.
This thing is frozen too hard to bite.

lines.zh: 冰刺之地，我这牙都冻住了。
lines.en: In the ice spikes, even my teeth freeze.
This frozen meat is mine.
I carry it in my jaws; it is light.

lines.zh: 冷到嘴都僵了，正好咬住你。
lines.en: My jaw froze stiff; perfect for a bite.
There are eggs in my nest; I will not yield.
You cracked the ice I guard.
Target: the one cracking my ice.
I keep this ice field.

lines.zh: 再近一步，冰刺就长出来。
lines.en: One more step and the spikes rise.
Beneath the ice, my tail moves.
Who is moving my ice nest?

lines.zh: 冰刺之地这么大，就你了。
lines.en: The ice spikes are wide, so you will do.

lines.zh: 冰刺之地的甲，比冰还硬。
lines.en: My ice-spike plates are harder than ice.
The ice is slick. Let me steady first.
One open mouth and the cold comes first.
You broke my ice; pay for it.

lines.zh: 我把你抛起来，再等落下。
lines.en: I throw you up and wait for the fall.

lines.zh: 我把你抛上去，再补一口毒。
lines.en: I toss you up, then add venom.
Do not make me swing my tail.
I know the ice spikes better than you.
You run on the ice; I crawl.
There is no cover on the ice.

lines.zh: 冰面上的鞋印，还没冻实。
lines.en: Your bootprints have not frozen over yet.
After this chase, I will bask on the ice.
After this fight, back to our holes.

lines.zh: 冰刺上的鳄，张嘴只是警告。
lines.en: A gator on ice spikes: open jaws are only a warning.
Spikes rise from my back.
One tail sweep knocks you down.
My teeth beat my claws.
You stepped onto my ice.
I throw you up, then bite.
I bit empty air and hit the ice.
My jaws close and ice chips fly.
One bite freezes your hand.
My first bite is fish under the ice.
The snow glare makes me squint.
Among the ice spikes, I raise my head.
Slid across the ice — which way now?

lines.zh: 雪地底下的草，我扒开找。
lines.en: Under the snow I root for grass.
Just hatched, my spikes have not grown.

lines.zh: 我从冰层下顶开一个洞。
lines.en: I push a hole up through the ice.
Seems I slept a long time.

lines.zh: 喉咙里，先冒出一口白气。
lines.en: A puff of white breath leaves my throat.
I know the wind of the ice spikes.
Fire melts my ice shell.

lines.zh: 我被摔在冰上，鳞都裂了。
lines.en: I landed on the ice and my scales cracked.

lines.zh: 冰刺之地里，我的皮冻硬了。
lines.en: In the ice spikes, my hide has frozen stiff.
My ice shell bursts and flips me over.

lines.zh: 谁在冰刺后面放箭？出来！
lines.en: Who shoots from behind the ice spikes? Come out!

lines.zh: 冰下的皮，被法术烫了一下。
lines.en: Spellfire bit my ice-bound hide.
One fish under the ice would do.
The Ice Spikes leave nowhere to hide.
In the void, there is not even cold.
